The '''Alliance base''' was a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] constructed into the base of a cliff on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odessen]]. It would serve as the Alliance's base of operations during the [[War against Zakuul|war]] against the [[Eternal Empire]],<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 9" /> and later as its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] as the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="KOTET Chapter 9" />
